chapter_text_kjv.1: And it came to pass afterward, that he went throughout every city and village, preaching and shewing the glad tidings of the kingdom of Elohim (God): and the twelve were with him,
chapter_text_kjv.2: And certain women, which had been healed of evil spirits and infirmities, Mary called Magdalene, out of whom went seven devils,
chapter_text_kjv.3: And Joanna the wife of Chuza Herod’s steward, and Susanna, and many others, which ministered unto him of their substance.
chapter_text_kjv.4: And when much people were gathered together, and were come to him out of every city, he spake by a parable:
chapter_text_kjv.5: A sower went out to sow his seed: and as he sowed, some fell by the way side; and it was trodden down, and the fowls of the air devoured it.
chapter_text_kjv.6: And some fell upon a rock; and as soon as it was sprung up, it withered away, because it lacked moisture.
chapter_text_kjv.7: And some fell among thorns; and the thorns sprang up with it, and choked it.
chapter_text_kjv.8: And other fell on good ground, and sprang up, and bare fruit an hundredfold. And when he had said these things, he cried, He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.
chapter_text_kjv.9: And his disciples asked him, saying, What might this parable be?

chapter_text_kjv.12: Those by the way side are they that hear; then cometh the devil, and taketh away the word out of their hearts, lest they should believe and be saved.
chapter_text_kjv.13: They on the rock are they, which, when they hear, receive the word with joy; and these have no root, which for a while believe, and in time of temptation fall away.
chapter_text_kjv.14: And that which fell among thorns are they, which, when they have heard, go forth, and are choked with cares and riches and pleasures of this life, and bring no fruit to perfection.
chapter_text_kjv.15: But that on the good ground are they, which in an honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.
chapter_text_kjv.16: No man, when he hath lighted a candle, covereth it with a vessel, or putteth it under a bed; but setteth it on a candlestick, that they which enter in may see the light.
chapter_text_kjv.17: For nothing is secret, that shall not be made manifest; neither any thing hid, that shall not be known and come abroad.
chapter_text_kjv.18: Take heed therefore how ye hear: for whosoever hath, to him shall be given; and whosoever hath not, from him shall be taken even that which he seemeth to have.
chapter_text_kjv.19: Then came to him his mother and his brethren, and could not come at him for the press.
chapter_text_kjv.20: And it was told him by certain which said, Thy mother and thy brethren stand without, desiring to see thee.
chapter_text_kjv.21: And he answered and said unto them, My mother and my brethren are these which hear the word of Elohim (God), and do it.
chapter_text_kjv.22: Now it came to pass on a certain day, that he went into a ship with his disciples: and he said unto them, Let us go over unto the other side of the lake. And they launched forth.
chapter_text_kjv.23: But as they sailed he fell asleep: and there came down a storm of wind on the lake; and they were filled with water, and were in jeopardy.
chapter_text_kjv.24: And they came to him, and awoke him, saying, Master, master, we perish. Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm.
chapter_text_kjv.25: And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him.
chapter_text_kjv.26: And they arrived at the country of the Gadarenes, which is over against Galilee.
chapter_text_kjv.27: And when he went forth to land, there met him out of the city a certain man, which had devils long time, and ware no clothes, neither abode in any house, but in the tombs.
chapter_text_kjv.28: When he saw Yahusha (Jesus), he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Yahusha (Jesus), thou Son of Elohim (God) most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.
chapter_text_kjv.29: (For he had commanded the unclean spirit to come out of the man. For oftentimes it had caught him: and he was kept bound with chains and in fetters; and he brake the bands, and was driven of the devil into the wilderness.)
chapter_text_kjv.30: And Yahusha (Jesus) asked him, saying, What is thy name? And he said, Legion: because many devils were entered into him.
chapter_text_kjv.31: And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.
chapter_text_kjv.32: And there was there an herd of many swine feeding on the mountain: and they besought him that he would suffer them to enter into them. And he suffered them.
chapter_text_kjv.33: Then went the devils out of the man, and entered into the swine: and the herd ran violently down a steep place into the lake, and were choked.
chapter_text_kjv.34: When they that fed them saw what was done, they fled, and went and told it in the city and in the country.
chapter_text_kjv.35: Then they went out to see what was done; and came to Yahusha (Jesus), and found the man, out of whom the devils were departed, sitting at the feet of Yahusha (Jesus), clothed, and in his right mind: and they were afraid.
chapter_text_kjv.36: They also which saw it told them by what means he that was possessed of the devils was healed.
chapter_text_kjv.37: Then the whole multitude of the country of the Gadarenes round about besought him to depart from them; for they were taken with great fear: and he went up into the ship, and returned back again.
chapter_text_kjv.38: Now the man out of whom the devils were departed besought him that he might be with him: but Yahusha (Jesus) sent him away, saying,
chapter_text_kjv.39: Return to thine own house, and shew how great things Elohim (God) hath done unto thee. And he went his way, and published throughout the whole city how great things Yahusha (Jesus) had done unto him.
chapter_text_kjv.40: And it came to pass, that, when Yahusha (Jesus) was returned, the people gladly received him: for they were all waiting for him.
chapter_text_kjv.41: And, behold, there came a man named Jairus, and he was a ruler of the synagogue: and he fell down at Yahusha's (Jesus’) feet, and besought him that he would come into his house:
chapter_text_kjv.42: For he had one only daughter, about twelve years of age, and she lay a dying. But as he went the people thronged him.
chapter_text_kjv.43: And a woman having an issue of blood twelve years, which had spent all her living upon physicians, neither could be healed of any,
chapter_text_kjv.44: Came behind him, and touched the border of his garment: and immediately her issue of blood stanched.
chapter_text_kjv.45: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Who touched me? When all denied, Peter and they that were with him said, Master, the multitude throng thee and press thee, and sayest thou, Who touched me?
chapter_text_kjv.46: And Yahusha (Jesus) said, Somebody hath touched me: for I perceive that virtue is gone out of me.
chapter_text_kjv.47: And when the woman saw that she was not hid, she came trembling, and falling down before him, she declared unto him before all the people for what cause she had touched him, and how she was healed immediately.
chapter_text_kjv.48: And he said unto her, Daughter, be of good comfort: thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.
chapter_text_kjv.49: While he yet spake, there cometh one from the ruler of the synagogue’s house, saying to him, Thy daughter is dead; trouble not the Master.
chapter_text_kjv.50: But when Yahusha (Jesus) heard it, he answered him, saying, Fear not: believe only, and she shall be made whole.
chapter_text_kjv.51: And when he came into the house, he suffered no man to go in, save Peter, and James, and John, and the father and the mother of the maiden.
chapter_text_kjv.52: And all wept, and bewailed her: but he said, Weep not; she is not dead, but sleepeth.
chapter_text_kjv.53: And they laughed him to scorn, knowing that she was dead.
chapter_text_kjv.54: And he put them all out, and took her by the hand, and called, saying, Maid, arise.
chapter_text_kjv.55: And her spirit came again, and she arose straightway: and he commanded to give her meat.
chapter_text_kjv.56: And her parents were astonished: but he charged them that they should tell no man what was done.

threads.title: The word sown and the law bringing fruit — 2 Esdras and the parable of the sower
threads.summary_md: Luke 8:4-15's parable of the sower walks an architecture the Hebrew library's 2 Esdras had named explicitly: the seed is the word-law of the Father sown into the heart, and the bringing-forth-of-fruit is the heart's keeping of what was sown. Luke 8:11 names the seed: *Now the parable is this: The seed is the word of Elohim (God).* 2 Esdras 9:31 names the same word-law-sown-to-bring-fruit register: *for, behold, I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you, and you shall be honoured in it for ever.* 2 Esdras 8:41 names the not-all-the-seed-takes-root diagnostic of the rock-ground and the wayside: *for as the husbandman sows much seed upon the ground ... yet the thing that is sown good in his season comes not up, neither does all that is planted take root: even so is it of them that are sown in the world; they shall not all be saved.* 2 Esdras 9:33 names the keeping-or-perishing verdict that Luke 8:15 lands as the good-ground outcome: *yet they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them* — the inverse of Luke 8:15's *honest and good heart, having heard the word, keep it, and bring forth fruit with patience.* The fruit is the keeping; the perishing is the not-keeping. The wisdom-apocalyptic stream had named the word-sown-to-bring-fruit and the keep-it-or-perish architecture before the King spoke the parable; the gospel walks the same architecture at the kingdom-citizens hearer-level. This is the word-seed received-and-kept register, distinct from the good-and-evil-seed-in-the-heart-of-Adam register that the existing 2 Esdras 4 thread carries.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: 2 Esdras 9:31 — *I sow my law in you, and it shall bring fruit in you.* The seed is the word of Elohim (God) at Luke 8:11, and the word sown is the law.
2 Esdras 8:41 — *neither does all that is planted take root.* The rock hearers of Luke 8:13 spring up with no root and fall away.
2 Esdras 9:33 — *they that received it perished, because they kept not the thing that was sown in them.* The good ground of Luke 8:15 hears the word and keeps it; the fruit is the keeping.

threads.title: Storm stilled by the Formed-One's rebuke — creation-authority in flesh on the deck
threads.summary_md: Verifier-added per the proposal-set lock. The Lukan storm-stilling at Luke 8:22-25 is a distinct episode from the walking-on-the-sea; the framework reads it as the Formed-One's creation-authority exercised in flesh on the deck. *Master, master, we perish... Then he arose, and rebuked the wind and the raging of the water: and they ceased, and there was a calm. And he said unto them, Where is your faith? And they being afraid wondered, saying one to another, What manner of man is this! for he commandeth even the winds and water, and they obey him* (Luke 8:24-25). The rebuking-the-sea move is Tehillim (Psalm) 107:29's *He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still* — Yahuah-prerogative exercised in flesh. Tehillim 89:9 — *Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them* — names the same substance. Iyov (Job) 38:11 — *Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed* — names the creation-word at which the sea was bounded. The disciples' question *What manner of man is this?* rehearses the framework's central identification: the one in the boat is the one who bounded the sea at creation, exercising the same authority in flesh.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: *Hitherto shalt thou come, but no further: and here shall thy proud waves be stayed.* Iyov (Job) 38:8-11's creation-word at which the sea was bounded — the same voice that gave the sea its bounds at creation now gives it the same word on the deck.

*Thou rulest the raging of the sea: when the waves thereof arise, thou stillest them.* Tehillim (Psalm) 89:9 names the ruling-of-the-raging-sea as Yahuah's prerogative — the same prerogative the Formed-One carries in flesh.
*He maketh the storm a calm, so that the waves thereof are still.* Tehillim (Psalm) 107:29 names the same sea-mastery substance the King exercises on the deck — Yahuah-prerogative carried in flesh.
The Matthean parallel — *What manner of man is this, that even the winds and the sea obey him!* — same disciples' question, same framework-substance recognition.

The Markan parallel — *they feared exceedingly, and said one to another, What manner of man is this, that even the wind and the sea obey him?* — synoptic-witness to the same creation-authority demonstration.

threads.title: Legion into the deep — the spirits of the giants and the place of condemnation in 1 Enoch and Jubilees
threads.summary_md: The spirits in the man at Gerasa know who has come ashore: *When he saw Yahusha (Jesus), he cried out, and fell down before him, and with a loud voice said, What have I to do with thee, Yahusha (Jesus), thou Son of Elohim (God) most high? I beseech thee, torment me not.* (Luke 8:28). And they know where they are headed: *And they besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep.* (Luke 8:31). Enoch tells where such spirits came from and why they dread the deep. *And now, the giants, who are produced from the spirits and flesh, shall be called evil spirits upon the earth, and on the earth shall be their dwelling.* (1 Enoch 15:8). *Evil spirits have proceeded from their bodies; because they are born from men and from the holy Watchers is their beginning and primal origin; they shall be evil spirits on earth, and evil spirits shall they be called.* (1 Enoch 15:9). They have a season, and it has an end already written: *From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated.”* (1 Enoch 16:1). Noah asked for them to be shut away before the end: *And You know how Your Watchers, the fathers of these spirits, acted in my day: and as for these spirits which are living, imprison them and hold them fast in the place of condemnation, and let them not bring destruction on the sons of your servant, my Elohim (God); for these are malignant, and created in order to destroy.* (Jubilees 10:5). So Legion is begging not to be sent early to the place Noah prayed them into and Enoch said they are bound for. The torment they fear is the deep before their appointed day, and the One standing on the shore in flesh is the One who holds that day.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: 1 Enoch 15:10 — *as for the spirits of heaven, in heaven shall be their dwelling, but as for the spirits of the earth which were born upon the earth, on the earth shall be their dwelling.* The earth-dwelling demon-origin; Luke 8:29's unclean spirit that drove the man into the wilderness is an earthbound spirit of the order 1 Enoch names.

*From the days of the slaughter and destruction and death of the giants, from the souls of whose flesh the spirits, having gone forth, shall destroy without incurring judgement—thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated, over the Watchers and the godless, yea, shall be wholly consummated."* (1 Enoch 16:1). *What have I to do with thee, Yahusha (Jesus), thou Son of Elohim (God) most high? I beseech thee, torment me not* (Luke 8:28). The spirits know the day of the consummation is appointed for them; Enoch records that they destroy only until it. The demoniac's cry is the fear of a sentence already written.

1 Enoch 16:1 — *thus shall they destroy until the day of the consummation, the great judgement in which the age shall be consummated.* The appointed-consummation the spirits dread; Luke 8:31's Legion *besought him that he would not command them to go out into the deep* — the confinement appointed against the day of judgment.

Jubilees 10:5 — *imprison them and hold them fast in the place of condemnation, and let them not bring destruction on the sons of your servant.* Noach's (Noah's) prayer names the place of condemnation; Luke 8:31's *not ... go out into the deep* is the same binding the library names as the spirits' appointed end. The Father alone exercises dominion (Jubilees 10:6); the King exercises it in flesh.

threads.title: My sheep hear my voice — hearing reveals what was true before the foundation
threads.summary_md:
The good shepherd discourse contains a sentence the inherited reading cannot hold without rewriting it. *Ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep.* The cause-and-effect is reversed from the gospel the modern pulpit preaches. The pulpit teaches *if you believe, you become a sheep.* The discourse teaches *if you are a sheep, you hear and believe.* The hearing is the revealing; the sheep-status is what is being revealed. The status precedes the response.

*But ye believe not, because ye are not of my sheep, as I said unto you. My sheep hear my voice, and I know them, and they follow me: and I give unto them eternal life; and they shall never perish, neither shall any man pluck them out of my hand. My Father, which gave them me, is greater than all; and no man is able to pluck them out of my Father's hand.* (John 10:26-29)

*Yahuah (the LORD) hath appeared of old unto me, saying, Yea, I have loved thee with an everlasting love: therefore with lovingkindness have I drawn thee.* (Jeremiah 31:3)

*And all that dwell upon the earth shall worship him, whose names are not written in the book of life of the Lamb slain from the foundation of the world.* (Revelation 13:8)

The Father gave them to the Son. The Father gave them before the foundation of the world. Their names were written then. The hearing of the shepherd's voice in time is the revealing of what was already true in the Father's foreknowledge — not the moment in which the sheep-status was created by the act of believing. The gathering of the scattered seed is not the recruitment of volunteers from the categorical nations; it is the homecoming of those whose names were written in the Lamb's book from the foundation.

This is why the gathering can be proclaimed broadly without the proclamation collapsing into a categorical invitation to all flesh. The proclamation goes out wherever the Father sends. Those who hear are revealed by their hearing to be sheep. Those who reject have the dust shaken off the foot, and the pearls are not cast before swine. The shepherd does not chase what was never his.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: *He that hath ears to hear, let him hear.* The same hearing-architecture Yochanan (John) 10:27 names — the sheep hear and turn, the hearing reveals what the Father had placed.

*Daughter, thy faith hath made thee whole; go in peace.* The second of four Lukan *thy faith hath saved/made-thee-whole* verdicts. The hearing reveals what the Father had placed; the *daughter* address names her in the seed-of-promise.

threads.title: The Gadarene demoniac, legion cast into the swine, and the eastern territory of the scattered
threads.summary_md: The first encounter on the eastern shore of the sea — the Decapolis, the country of the Gadarenes — is the King crossing into the territory of the lost tribes of Reuben, Gad, and the half-tribe of Manasseh whose inheritance lay east of the Yarden (Jordan). *And they came over unto the other side of the sea, into the country of the Gadarenes* (Mark 5:1). A man no man could bind, dwelling among tombs, cutting himself with stones — the scattered seed under unclean-spirit administration in the very land Mosheh (Moses) had assigned the eastern tribes. The legion that begs not to be sent out of the country names itself: *we are many.* The swine they enter and the steep place into the sea is the Watcher-spirit architecture being undone in the territory of the scattered, and the delivered man becomes the first proclaimer in Decapolis — *Go home to thy friends, and tell them how great things Yahuah (the Lord) hath done for thee* (Mark 5:19) — a scattered-territory mission before the Twelve are even sent.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: The Lukan parallel to the Markan Gerasene-demoniac (Luke renders it Gadarene). Same architecture — the King crosses the sea to the eastern shore (territory of Reuven (Reuben) / Gad / half-Manasseh), legion cast into swine, delivered man becomes first proclaimer.

threads.title: Talitha cumi — the twelve-year daughter of the house raised from sleep
threads.summary_md: *And he took the damsel by the hand, and said unto her, Talitha cumi; which is, being interpreted, Damsel, I say unto thee, arise* (Mark 5:41). The Aramaic preserved on the page is the King's own voice raising a daughter who has been twelve years on the earth — the same twelve years the woman with the issue of blood has been bleeding (Mark 5:25). Two daughters, one number. *The damsel is not dead, but sleepeth* (Mark 5:39) is the same word the prophets used of the covenant dead — *many that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake* (Daniel 12:2). The twelve-year sleep of the daughter of the house of the ruler of the synagogue is a sign in miniature of the first resurrection — the worthy of the seed raised at the King's own word, the language preserved in the tongue the people heard him speak.

members_in_this_chapter.member_note: The Lukan parallel to the Markan raising of Yair's (Jairus's) daughter, paired with the woman with the issue of blood — both twelve-year-women. Luke renders the Aramaic *Talitha cumi* differently (just *Maid, arise,* Luke 8:54), but the framework architecture is the same.

threads.title: Whosoever shall do the will of my Father — the true family (Proverbs 26; Deuteronomy 33; Psalm 22)
threads.summary_md: The unclean spirit that left returns to find the house *empty, swept, and garnished* — and brings seven worse. *As a dog returneth to his vomit, so a fool returneth to his folly* (Proverbs 26:11): a repentance that empties the heart but does not fill it with obedience leaves the door open, and *the last state of that man is worse than the first.* Then the true house is named. When his mother and brethren stand without, Yahusha defines kinship not by blood but by the Father's will — the very loyalty of Levi: *Who said unto his father and to his mother, I have not seen him... for they have observed thy word, and kept thy covenant* (Deuteronomy 33:9). The Messiah gathers an obedient family and calls them brethren: *I will declare thy name unto my brethren: in the midst of the congregation will I praise thee* (Psalm 22:22). *For whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother.* This is the seal against every lawless reading — the will of the Father is His commandment, and the true family is the one that does it.

threads.title: The sower — by hearing ye shall hear and shall not understand (Isaiah 6; Isaiah 55; Ezekiel 12)
threads.summary_md: When the disciples ask *Why speakest thou unto them in parables?* (13:10), Yahusha (Jesus) answers not with a new mystery but with an old wound. *And in them is fulfilled the prophecy of Isaiah, which saith, By hearing ye shall hear, and shall not understand; and seeing ye shall see, and shall not perceive* (13:14) — the very commissioning Yahuah gave Isaiah: *Go, and tell this people, Hear ye indeed, but understand not; and see ye indeed, but perceive not* (Isaiah 6:9), *Make the heart of this people fat, and make their ears heavy, and shut their eyes; lest they... should understand with their heart, and convert, and be healed* (Isaiah 6:10). The parable is a mirror that shows each heart what it already is. Ezekiel heard the same diagnosis: *which have eyes to see, and see not; they have ears to hear, and hear not* (Ezekiel 12:2). Yet the seed itself is never barren. The sower of 13:3 sows the word that comes down like rain — *it shall not return unto me void, but it shall accomplish that which I please* (Isaiah 55:11); only the soil refuses, the thorny ground that Jeremiah commanded be broken: *Break up your fallow ground, and sow not among thorns* (Jeremiah 4:3). The same Isaiah 6 word frames the whole proclamation: Yochanan quotes it (John 12:40), and Sha'ul (Paul) closes Acts with it (Acts 28:26). The good ground is simply the heart that lets the word in.

threads.title: Wisdom hidden from the wicked and revealed to the elect — 1 Enoch 48, 2 Esdras 5, Wisdom of Solomon 1, and Sirach 39 beside Matthew 13:10-17
threads.summary_md: When the disciples ask why he speaks to the crowds in parables, Yahusha (Jesus) answers with a passive verb: *He answered and said unto them, Because it is given unto you to know the mysteries of the kingdom of heaven, but to them it is not given.* (Matthew 13:11). It has been given, before the hearing, and then he quotes Isaiah 6: *they seeing see not; and hearing they hear not, neither do they understand.* The giving comes first, and the hearing shows who received it. Enoch was shown the same order at the fountain of wisdom: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). The Son is revealed to the holy and righteous whose lot the Father preserved, according to his good pleasure. The rest of the library says it from the other side. The Wisdom of Solomon warns that *into a malicious soul wisdom shall not enter; nor dwell in the body that is subject unto sin* (Wisdom of Solomon 1:4). Ezra is told that in the last days wisdom and understanding withdraw into their secret chamber and are sought of many and not found (2 Esdras 5:9-10). Sirach says the spirit of understanding is poured out on the scribe when the great Yahuah (LORD) wills it (Ecclesiasticus 39:6). The Father does not slam a door on anyone; the soul that loves its sin closes itself, and wisdom, meeting the closed door, passes by. So the disciples do not earn the mysteries by being clever, and the crowd does not lose them by being dull. The ones who hear were given to hear, and the hearing reveals what was already true of them. That is what he means when he says elsewhere that his sheep hear his voice.

threads.title: Mysteries hidden from the foundation of the world revealed to the elect — 1 Enoch 46 and 48, Wisdom of Solomon 6, 2 Esdras 6
threads.summary_md: *All these things spake Yahusha (Jesus) unto the multitude in parables; and without a parable spake he not unto them:* (Matthew 13:34) *That it might be fulfilled which was spoken by the prophet, saying, I will open my mouth in parables; I will utter things which have been kept secret from the foundation of the world.* (Matthew 13:35). The psalm he is fulfilling is Asaph's, and the pattern of things hidden since the foundation and then opened to a chosen few runs all through the library. Enoch saw the one who does the opening, and was told who he is: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). He was himself the first thing hidden: *And for this reason hath he been chosen and hidden before Him, Before the creation of the world and for evermore.* (1 Enoch 48:6). *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). Solomon speaks the same way as a teacher: *as for wisdom, what she is, and how she came up, I will tell you, and will not hide mysteries from you* (Wisdom of Solomon 6:22), and Ezra is told of the last days when *the truth, which hath been so long without fruit, shall be declared* (2 Esdras 6:28). So when the King speaks in parables to the crowd and opens them to the disciples, he is doing the work Enoch saw the Son of Adam doing, revealing the treasures of what was hidden, and the disciples receive it because, as he had just told them from Isaiah 6, it was given to them to receive. The sower of the good seed in the next verse is this same Son of Adam.

threads.title: Children of Elohim by doing the Father's will — the son-of-the-Most-High identity-marker — Wisdom of Solomon 2, Sirach 4, Jubilees 1
threads.summary_md: Matt 12:46-50's kingdom-family-redefinition closing — *whosoever shall do the will of my Father which is in heaven, the same is my brother, and sister, and mother* — read against the wisdom-stream's children-of-Elohim-by-doing-the-Father's-will architecture. Four moves: Wisdom of Solomon 2:13-15 names the child-of-Elohim-by-the-righteous-disposition architecture — *he calleth himself the child of Yahuah (the Lord) ... his life is not like other men's, his ways are of another fashion*; Wisdom of Solomon 2:18 names the son-of-Elohim-tested-by-deliverance architecture — *if the just man be the son of Elohim (God), he will help him*; Sirach (Ecclesiasticus) 4:10 names THE strongest wisdom-stream verbal-anchor for the doing-the-Father's-substance-makes-thee-a-son architecture — *be as a father unto the fatherless ... so shalt thou be as the son of the most High*; Jubilees 1:24 names the souls-cleaving-to-Yahuah-and-fulfilling-the-commandments yields the Father-and-children-relation architecture — *they will fulfil My commandments, and I shall be their Father and they will be My children.* The framework reads the cluster against Matt 12:50: the kingdom-family-recognition-criterion is the same doing-the-Father's-will substance the wisdom-stream had named as the operative-form of the son-of-the-Most-High identity. The same criterion is the kingdom-entry-criterion at Matt 7:21 (*not every one that saith unto me, Lord, Lord, shall enter into the kingdom of heaven; but he that doeth the will of my Father*), and the 1 John 2:3-4 master-filter restates it: *if we keep his commandments.* The wisdom-stream and the gospel name one architecture across two registers — the kingdom-family is identified by the heart-Torah-walking-disposition the prophets named, the wisdom-stream named, and the King names operative in the kingdom's inauguration.
